mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_course (user_id, course_id, source, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{source}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT uc.course_id, c.title, c.description, c.cover_url, c.price, uc.source, uc.create_time FROM user_course uc JOIN course c ON c.course_id = uc.course_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.create_time DESC, uc.id DESC
